voci.titolo: Silver Market Set for Deficit Even as Solar Makers Cut Back

voci.titolo: Australia Bond Yield Falls Below US Peer as Rate Paths Diverge

voci.riassunto: Fed Chair Warsh’s quiet style of communicating interest-rate policy has led to more volatile markets.
